description: Globale Grundwassergefährdung durch Hochwasser und Dürre (WHYMAP GWV) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by download.bgr.de. The World-wide Hydrogeological Mapping and Assessment Programme (WHYMAP) provides data and information about the earth´s major groundwater resources. The Map of Global Groundwater Vulnerability to Floods and Droughts indicates the vulnerability level of groundwater resources of the earth. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Global Groundwater Vulnerability to Floods and Droughts (WHYMAP GWV)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Weltweit, Aquifer, Groundwater recharge, Grundwasserneubildung, Geology, Grundwasservorkommen. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
